metadata.question: Were the sea surface temperatures near the coast of La Jolla, California on August 1, 2018 higher than the same region's sea surface temperature the year prior?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: La Jolla, California coast (approximately 32.85°N, -117.27°W) - Dates: August 1, 2018 vs August 1, 2017 - Collection: NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1 (daily sea surface temperature) or HYCOM sea surface temperature 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for sea surface temperature products - These are already processed ocean temperature datasets - May need to filter for ocean areas only (not land) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid SST should be in reasonable range (typically -2°C to 35°C for ocean surface) - Compare 2018 vs 2017 values - Check if both dates have valid data - A result of None, NaN, or out-of-range temperatures would be C3 - If no images found for either date: C1 - If images exist but no valid pixels: C2 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const laJolla = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.27, 32.85]); const date2018 = ee.Date('2018-08-01'); const date2017 = ee.Date('2017-08-01'); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const sst2018 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1') .filterDate(date2018, date2018.advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(laJolla) .select('sst'); const sst2017 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1') .filterDate(date2017, date2017.advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(laJolla) .select('sst'); const size2018 = await sst2018.size().getInfo(); const size2017 = await sst2017.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 Images: ${size2018}`); console.log(`2017 Images: ${size2017}`); if (size2018 === 0 || size2017 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both years."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing & Calculation const img2018 = sst2018.first(); const img2017 = sst2017.first(); const stats2018 = await img2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: laJolla.buffer(5000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2017 = await img2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: laJolla.buffer(5000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const temp2018 = stats2018['sst_mean']; const temp2017 = stats2017['sst_mean']; const count2018 = stats2018['sst_count']; const count2017 = stats2017['sst_count']; console.log(`2018: ${temp2018}°C (Pixels: ${count2018})`); console.log(`2017: ${temp2017}°C (Pixels: ${count2017})`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (count2018 === 0 || count2017 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (temp2018 === null || temp2017 === null || temp2018 < -5 || temp2018 > 40 || temp2017 < -5 || temp2017 > 40) { console.log("Invalid temperature values."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (temp2018 > temp2017) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
